author: Kushal
problem: Takahashi grew D cm every year from birth until age X and then stopped growing. Read N M X T D, where T is his height at age N (N >= X), and print his height at age M (M <= N).
bug_description: Uses T + (X - M) * D instead of T - (X - M) * D, adding the remaining growth instead of subtracting it.

comments.accurate: Prints the height at age M by working back from the final height T
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the height at age M as T plus the growth from age M up to X
comments.wrong_location: Growth formula verified; check the M >= X branch for ages after growth stopped
